name: London System
description: A simple setup opening where White develops smoothly and builds a sturdy center.

moves.explanation: White takes space in the center and opens the c1 bishop.
Black challenges the same central squares.
The bishop comes outside the pawn chain before e3, creating an easy development plan.

ideas: Put the dark-squared bishop on f4 early.
Build with e3, Nf3, Bd3, and short castling.
Keep the center solid before starting an attack.
commonMistakes: Locking the bishop in with e3 too soon.
Forgetting that Black can challenge the center with c5.
